structured_output.what_is_happening: TOE ROGAN ($TOE) is a pump.fun meme launched about 14 minutes before detection (created 11:33 UTC, graduated to PumpSwap at 11:36). Its only link is an X post by @joeroganhq (status 2103809558397526244), which returned HTTP 402 so I could not read it. The description says "Fees to @joerogan via UsePaid", a creator-fee-to-celebrity angle. "Toe Rogan" is an old parody joke about Joe Rogan's name: there is a @JoeTheToeRogan parody account and a toe-stub deepfake. I found no current real-world "toe" news event. At least 9 other TOE ROGAN clones appeared within minutes, which suggests a trigger post that pump.fun deployers jumped on together. This contract is the earliest and has the highest market cap and volume, about $184k market cap against an ATH of about $209k. It rose 267% in 11 minutes with $327k of volume.

The creator has launched 72 tokens (best ATH about $209k, roughly the current level) and has closed out their position. Community-takeover flag. On the other side: about 1,600 unique buyers, top 10 hold only 18%, 22 smart wallets and 3 renowned wallets, and no paid boosts.
